title: Spicy Earthy Stir-Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy stir-fry made with earthy mushrooms and a hint of Spanish spice. Serve hot over a bed of rice for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and chili flakes and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Add the stir-fry vegetables and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Stir in the soy sauce and cook for 1 minute.
Reduce heat to low and stir in the crumbled goat cheese.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the mixture is heated through.
Serve hot over a bed of rice and enjoy!
